name: 092 — The address reaches the end
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for the whole of feature 092: the addressed twins of a Position's own verbs, worldToScreen moved beside its inverse and projecting at the point's own height, screenToWorld taking the shape the other half hands back, the layout sweep reaching every tree, a remembered placement filed under the tree its widget stands in, a visual write on a gob re-applying when another session loads it, the change-detection adapters reading their own session, and a graphics setting reaching every scene.
